node.title: Rank-eleven dense roots saturate the high coefficient span
node.closure: monic dense-root factorization and triangular recovery force every absorbing correction space to equal the fixed ten-dimensional deviation space
node.statement: For the fixed rank-eleven relative core, the deviation interpolant vanishes at eighteen dense-pair anchor slopes and ten other anchor values span V'. Factoring the monic degree-18 dense-root locator from its degree-at-most-31 deviation polynomial shows that coefficients in degrees 18 through 31 span every quotient coefficient and hence all of V'. These are high coefficients of H. Therefore every correction space W<=V' which absorbs all high coefficients equals V' and has dimension exactly ten. Absorbing dimensions two through nine are empty; component aggregation remains open.
